A1.justification: Both complete 26-page PDFs describe Universal Few-Shot Spatial Control for Diffusion Models and include Appendices A–F. Text, equations, tables and figures support reliable comparison throughout.

before.justification: v1 reports original UFC experiments, including quantitative comparisons in Tables 1–6, ablations, support-set analyses and qualitative generation results.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original quantitative experiments, ablations, support-set analyses and qualitative results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Appendices A and D retain identical patch-wise matching, parameter adaptation, training objectives and control-feature injection procedures for UNet and DiT backbones.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same LAION-400M training subset, COCO 2017, ImageNet-R-TI2I and iso3d evaluations. Coverage remains six principal spatial conditions plus meshes, wireframes and point clouds.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain the same ControlNet, Uni-ControlNet, Prompt Diffusion and Ctrl-X comparisons, including the same fine-tuned variants. Appendix B/Table 5 retains FreeControl and Ctrl-X.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 and the appendices preserve all splits, support sizes, preprocessing, metrics, training budgets and inference settings. The smaller ImageNet-R-TI2I evaluation protocol is also unchanged.

E4.justification: Section 5.3 and Appendix C retain the matching and fine-tuning ablations, support-size and support-selection sensitivity analyses, and attention visualizations. No analysis or case study is added or removed.

E5.justification: Inference seed 42 and Appendix C/Table 6's support-set runs, means and standard deviations are identical. No repeated-run information or uncertainty reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative examples match. For example, Table 1 retains UFC's Canny SSIM of 0.3239 and Pose AP50 of 0.229; appendix results and plotted trends are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The problem definitions and mathematical formulations in Sections 3–4 and Appendix A.1, including Equations 1–12, are identical. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about universal few-shot spatial control, adaptation with 30 examples, competitiveness using 0.1% of training data, and compatibility with UNet and DiT.

C2.justification: Interpretations of matching, support diversity and backbone performance remain identical. Section 6 retains the limitations concerning appearance-preserving tasks and the need for per-task fine-tuning; appendix evaluation limitations are unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, timing, dataset construction and the five inference support pairs remain unchanged. Code and checkpoint access information is also identical.

R1.justification: Section 2, research positioning and all 60 reference entries are unchanged. No cited work or substantive relationship to prior research is added or removed.

P1.justification: The margin stamp changes from v1 dated 9 September 2025 to v2 dated 14 January 2026. PDF author metadata corrects 'Chanhuyk Lee' to 'Chanhyuk Lee'; the visible author line, body wording and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: All figures, tables, captions and content layouts are unchanged. Rendered pages 2–26 are identical, and the only visible difference on page 1 is the arXiv version/date stamp.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, evidence, explanations and presentation remain identical across the main text and Appendices A–F. The version/date update and author-metadata correction do not meaningfully change the paper's overall quality.
